description.source_copy: We send a six-digit code to your university address to confirm you are a current student.
description.approved_local_copy: This local account uses the fixed code 009789. No email is sent. This does not verify your university or student identity.

privacy_card.source_copy: Your address is used once for verification and stays private. It is never shown to other students and never used for marketing.
privacy_card.approved_local_copy: Your address identifies your account on this device. It stays private and is never shown on your profile.

source_states.invalid_email: goVerCode pings Enter your university email and stays on the page

source_states.supported_domain: sets a 42 second resend timer and routes to Code

motion.entry: cRise 240ms ease both; opacity 0 and translateY(14px) to opacity 1 and translateY(0)

approved_deltas.delta: Replace prototype system chrome and footer compensation with measured safe areas, fixed header/footer and one flex middle scroll region while preserving reference coordinates.

approved_deltas.source: User authorized fixed local verification code 009789 and explicitly deferred real email verification
approved_deltas.delta: Do not claim that an email was sent or that the fixed code verifies university/student identity. Use the locked approved local title, heading, description, privacy statement and button copy while preserving the source typography, cards and spacing.

The normal page requires a real pending local account or the same authenticated local account. Missing/expired context shows an explicit recovery error and Log In action; it must not invent an account just to reproduce the standalone source input.

Editing remains in memory. A changed valid unique email shows custom 400-600ms Loading and atomically updates only the pending account before opening Code; conflict or persistence failure stays here with no partial write. An unchanged address navigates without a fake write or Loading.
Retire the prototype unsupported-domain branch for this local-only flow. Any syntactically valid unique email may identify the local account; no domain is treated as proof of enrollment.
Back restores the actual origin instance; direct entry falls back to Signup. Change Email from Code restores this page rather than creating another registration.

When the real keyboard reduces visualViewport height, keep the email input in the only scroll region and temporarily fold the fixed source footer; restore it when the keyboard closes. Default output remains unchanged.

historical_evidence.limit: The historical evidence proves the older local correction and fixed-code flow but is not a hash-locked empty/default pixel comparison and does not cover the real iOS keyboard or exact footer position.
